physical_execution_policy: Experiments, acquisition and calibration parked; formulation, derivation and rival analysis may proceed.

nodes.statement: One physically realized process account admits faithful stagewise realizations of all constructions in a fixed admissible mathematical scope, preserving identity, composition and licensed resource-dependent continuations.
nodes.scope_gate: Use the existing formulation-and-quantifiers obligation; do not duplicate the parent or silently choose its unresolved foundation and physical-process semantics.
nodes.rejection_condition: A no-realization theorem covering the fixed admissible source class and quantifier scope; a single failed compiler or encoding is insufficient.

nodes.statement: The common physical process account requires coherent noncommutative state/action structure: no realization in the independently delimited classical rival class preserves its full stagewise operational and resource interface.
nodes.quantifiers: There exists an admitted common process account P; for every rival realization R in a frozen classical class C, at least one required state/action/identity/resource/continuation comparison fails.
nodes.formulation_gate: Specify P, classical rival class C, observables, permitted contextuality/nonlocality, precision, computation and resource overhead independently of the desired exclusion. Quantum formalism in the simulator is not evidence for this hypothesis.
rivals: Classical simulation with additional memory and computation
Contextual or nonlocal classical process account
Quantum mechanics as effective rather than fundamental structure
nodes.acceptance: A full-interface obstruction for the declared rival class plus independent justification that P describes the physical source; no conclusion beyond that class.
nodes.rejection_condition: An admissible classical realization preserving every comparison and resource constraint for the fixed P.
nodes.present_evidence_boundary: Routing-only circuits are a restricted quantum gate class, not the class of classical theories. Their obstruction cannot establish quantum fundamentality.

nodes.statement: There exists an independently specified physical system and admissible sector carrying the native scalar projector, frozen source K and neutral-record dynamics through one faithful state/action/readout/resource map, including inactive carrier sectors and separate vacuum.
nodes.quantifiers: Exists a named physical system S, encoding V, preparation/readout instruments and control/resource accounting satisfying the frozen reaggregation comparison on every admitted input and continuation, not only the scalar preparation.
nodes.formulation_gate: Pin the physical candidate and admissible domains without fitting particle labels, coupling scale or energy offsets to target outputs. Physical system existence is unresolved, not supplied by a circuit diagram.
rivals: Programmable simulator only, with projector control externally supplied
A larger coherent record system with a different source map
No compatible realization in the selected physical candidate
nodes.acceptance: Full comparison witnesses plus independent physical-system provenance under the existing admission gate; empirical execution remains deferred.
nodes.rejection_condition: A failed required square refutes a fixed candidate; refuting the existential claim requires an obstruction covering its whole admitted candidate class.

nodes.scope: Source-addressed abstract quantum control; not physical source identification or uniquely selected dynamics.

edges.meaning: An additional quantum-irreducibility claim about the common process, not a consequence of the parent.
One scoped physical realization could supply an example; it cannot prove universal coverage.
Provides abstract maps and explicit extra control requirements, leaving physical provenance unmatched.
Any candidate limited to the frozen routing-only gate class cannot supply the required coherent controlled flip in that encoding.
A realization preserving this control cannot replace coherent source structure by the declared routing-only interface; other source classes remain possible.
Demonstrates why the classical rival class must not be conflated with a restricted quantum compiler class; no quantum-fundamentality evidence transfer.

outcome_propagation: None. Edges declare logical/research relations, not proof implication or Bayesian updates. Existing outcomes remain unchanged.
